Working tree is identical to the run's start — only the pre-existing `.qa-*` test artifacts and the two untracked overnight JSON files are dirty. No code changes, so no commit (consistent with the established "0 fixes → 0 commits" charter).

## Summary

**Run 51, s2-frontend-test — COMPLETE. 0 bugs found, 0 fixes, 0 commits.**

I logged into the app with Playwright (server on `:3001`, UI on `:5173`) and completed the **final un-swept portion of the tablet-768px frontend sweep**. The sweep is now 100% complete across the whole app.

**Tested at 768px (all clean — 0 overflow, 0 console errors):**
| Page | Result |
|---|---|
| Invoices, Reports, Subcontractors, Expenses, Contracts | ✅ clean |
| Settings — all 15 tabs (Profile → Reviews, incl. Financing) | ✅ clean |
| LeadDetail slide-over (full render: contact/property/weather/insurance/activity/tasks/docs/expenses/profit/quick-actions) | ✅ clean |
| Leads list, Storm Archive, Dashboard | ✅ clean |

Probe method: `scrollWidth−clientWidth` overflow + per-element `right > viewport` offender scan (filtering intentionally-scrollable containers), plus a console-error check on each page.

**Notable findings (none are bugs):**
- `/content-studio` is **not a route** — it's a future feature; the `*` wildcard correctly redirects unknown routes to `/`. Working as intended.
- The Financing tab (the `feat/financing` active-dev area) renders its 5-plan APR table cleanly.

**Why no fixes:** The two "gaps" carried in the resume are both out of charter/scope:
1. **Esc-to-close keyboard nav** — adding it where it never existed is a *new feature*; the charter explicitly forbids enhancements.
2. **EstimateBuilder 375px collapse** — phone width, and mobile is paused (web-app-only focus); it works fine at all supported widths (768px+).

The app is **converged on every QA axis**: backend (11 runs), UI-consistency (7 audits), and now the tablet-768px sweep (100% complete). I updated `overnight_resume.md` with this run's results so the next run knows there's nothing left to fix within the QA charter.
